author: SickProdigy
description: Publish official ARK: Survival Ascended Steam announcements as cards or article-style posts with configurable categories and role notifications.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild announcement settings and bounded Steam announcement IDs. It does not persistently store user data or metadata.
install_msg: Set an announcement channel with `[p]arkset channel #channel`, choose `[p]arkset mode card` or `[p]arkset mode article`, optionally set a notification role, then start automatic posting with `[p]arkset autopost start`. Existing Steam posts are seeded during setup and will not flood the channel.
name: ArkAnnouncements
short: Official ARK: Survival Ascended Steam announcements
